title: HB879 (2020 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2020/bills/HB879_.HTM; sha256 3519a149da28f2a2bddbe62e999c62552442e1809eaaa16061293cbc0fe0be90)
provenance.note: As-filed text. The 'ongoing duty' proviso and the no-penalty exception in HRS 134-17(b) and (d) sit in sentences with struck text, so are paraphrased. Same text in 2019 and 2020 files.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (HRS 134-3): Every person registering a firearm under this subsection shall be fingerprinted and photographed by the police department of the county of registration; provided that this requirement shall be waived where fingerprints and photographs are already on file with the police department.
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-17): Any person who violates section 134-2, 134-4, 134-10, 134-15, or 134-16(a) shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
